subject.title: feat(dashboard): sandboxed custom widgets + approval flow [3/3]

question: Should this enabled-by-default dashboard custom-widget stack merge only after the durable state format and unauthenticated widget-route security boundary are repaired and proven, or may maintainers accept explicit exceptions?
rationale: The PR creates persistent plugin state, a dependency graph delta, and a sandboxed unauthenticated asset-serving path; those are maintainer/security boundary choices rather than routine contributor follow-up.

options.title: Repair and prove before merge
options.body: Require SQLite/plugin-state storage or an approved storage exception, manifest entrypoint fidelity, scratch-file removal, dependency authorization, and redacted browser or terminal security diagnostics before reconsidering merge.

options.title: Accept documented exceptions
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept the JSON state store and unauthenticated route shape, but should document migration ownership and security proof requirements before landing.

options.title: Pause until stack is clean
options.body: Defer this top-stack PR until the backend and Workspaces UI prerequisite PRs land or rebase so the custom-widget boundary can be reviewed against the real merge result.

recommendation.title: Repair and prove before merge
recommendation.body: Require SQLite/plugin-state storage or an approved storage exception, manifest entrypoint fidelity, scratch-file removal, dependency authorization, and redacted browser or terminal security diagnostics before reconsidering merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision centers on dependency authorization and the sandbox/static-route security boundary routed through CODEOWNERS.
